author: kenchoo; original cat by guillaume bolis

walk_validation.scope: Blender evaluated skin at source scale; authored slow in-place gait, no measured animal or hardware acceptance

conversion: Original topology, albedo, eyes and 40-bone rig retained. UV2 source normals reprojected into a 1K tangent-space UV0 map for URP. Authored restrained idle/sniff and four-beat in-place walk replace the supplied clip; static whiskers bound to original head. Not motion capture; integration status in DEVELOPMENT_STATUS.md.

walk_trajectory.swing: Quintic Hermite longitudinal return matching stance velocity and zero acceleration at contact; sin^3 lift
walk_trajectory.export: 97 pose keys per 2-second cycle; FBX sampling/interpolation is checked separately, not claimed continuously C2
